title: Fingerprinting Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Collapsed Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proprietary text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distributed as hosted services and downloadable checkpoints, making their intellectual property (IP) protection an increasingly critical concern when model leakage, copying, or unauthorized fine-tuning is disputed. In this work, we present a non-invasive model fingerprinting framework based on \emph{collapsed generation}, a phenomenon where certain input conditions produce highly consistent images across multiple stochastic seeds. We show that collapsed generation is an intrinsic, model-dependent property of the learned generation process. These collapse-prone conditions therefore expose model-specific behavioral signatures, enabling reliable ownership verification without embedding invasive watermarks. translated_title: 通过坍缩生成对文本到图像扩散模型进行指纹识别
translated_abstract: 专有的文本到图像扩散模型日益以托管服务和可下载检查点的形式分发，这使得在模型泄露、复制或未经授权的微调引发争议时，其知识产权保护成为一个日益关键的问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于“坍缩生成”现象的非侵入式模型指纹识别框架。坍缩生成是指某些输入条件在多个随机种子下会产生高度一致图像的现象。我们表明，坍缩生成是学习生成过程中一种内在的、依赖模型的特性。因此，这些易坍缩的条件能够暴露模型特有的行为特征，从而在无需嵌入侵入性水印的情况下实现可靠的归属验证。在源模型上准备条件后，该框架可在两种访问设置下验证可疑模型：（1）白盒管道访问，其中优化连续嵌入（原文截断，此处根据上下文补充）用于验证；（2）黑盒API访问，仅通过查询响应进行验证。实验表明，该方法在多种模型架构上具有高准确性和鲁棒性，并能抵御常见后处理攻击。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用扩散模型坍缩生成现象进行非侵入式指纹识别的方法，通过识别特定输入条件导致的高度一致图像输出，在不嵌入水印的情况下可靠验证模型所有权。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a non-invasive fingerprinting framework for text-to-image diffusion models that exploits collapsed generation—where certain inputs yield highly consistent outputs—to reliably verify model ownership without invasive watermarks.
